theme.en: AI Infrastructure Spreads Across the Silicon Stack
theme.zh: AI基础设施贯穿整个硅栈

dek.en: AI capacity is no longer only a GPU story: memory, optical I/O, PCIe fabrics, advanced packaging, foundry capacity, and process-tool labs are all scaling around it. The day's announcements show the bottleneck—and the investment—moving through every layer of the hardware stack.
dek.zh: AI算力扩张已不只是GPU的故事：存储、光互连、PCIe互连、先进封装、晶圆代工和工艺设备实验室都在同步扩容。今日消息显示，瓶颈与投资正在硬件栈的各层之间转移。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Microchip Shows a 160-Lane PCIe Gen6 Switch at FMS 2026
title.zh: Microchip在FMS 2026展示160通道PCIe Gen6交换芯片

summary.en: Microchip demonstrated a 160-lane Switchtec PCIe Gen6 switch at FMS 2026 alongside an XpressConnect PCIe 6 retimer. The combination targets the signal reach and fabric fan-out needed to connect accelerators, memory, and hosts at rack scale. This is a trade-show demonstration rather than evidence of volume deployment, but it shows PCIe 6 infrastructure moving toward complete switching and retiming platforms.
summary.zh: Microchip在FMS 2026展示了160通道Switchtec PCIe Gen6交换芯片，并配套演示XpressConnect PCIe 6重定时器。该组合面向机架级加速器、存储与主机互连所需的信号传输距离和扇出能力。目前这仍是展会演示，而非规模部署，但说明PCIe 6基础设施正从单一器件走向完整的交换与重定时平台。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Sony and TSMC Plan a $6.3 Billion Image-Sensor Venture
title.zh: Sony与TSMC拟建$6.3B下一代图像传感器合资项目

summary.en: Sony and TSMC are planning a $6.3 billion joint venture for next-generation image sensors. If completed, the project would pair Sony's sensor franchise with TSMC's manufacturing scale and deepen the foundry's exposure to specialty imaging silicon beyond leading-edge logic. The report describes a plan, so ownership, location, process mix, and construction timing remain key open details.
summary.zh: Sony与TSMC计划成立规模达$6.3B的合资项目，生产下一代图像传感器。若项目落地，Sony的传感器业务将与TSMC的制造规模结合，也会让后者在先进逻辑之外进一步扩大特色图像芯片业务。报道目前仍停留在计划阶段，股权、选址、制程组合和建设时间仍是关键待定项。

title.en: Chinese Foundries Post Triple-Digit Quarterly Growth
title.zh: 中国晶圆代工厂录得季度三位数增长

summary.en: Chinese foundries recorded triple-digit quarterly growth, according to gasworld. The acceleration points to a sharp domestic manufacturing ramp, with implications for mature-node supply, industrial-gas demand, and equipment utilization. The candidate report does not specify whether the growth measure is revenue, output, or another operating metric, so the headline rate should not be read as a direct capacity figure.
summary.zh: 据gasworld报道，中国晶圆代工厂录得季度三位数增长。这一加速势头指向国内制造快速爬坡，并将影响成熟制程供给、工业气体需求和设备利用率。候选报道未说明增长口径是收入、产量还是其他运营指标，因此不能把标题中的增速直接等同于产能增幅。

title.en: Rapidus Targets Eight-Reticle Interposers by 2030
title.zh: Rapidus计划2030年实现八倍光罩尺寸中介层

summary.en: Rapidus is targeting interposers spanning eight reticles by 2030. That scale would support much larger multi-chip packages and reflects how advanced packaging is becoming part of the foundry roadmap, not a downstream afterthought. The date is a target rather than a production commitment, leaving process readiness, yield, and customer qualification to be demonstrated.
summary.zh: Rapidus计划到2030年实现覆盖八倍光罩尺寸的中介层。这一尺寸可承载更大的多芯片封装，也表明先进封装已进入晶圆代工路线图核心，而不再只是后段配套。2030年仍是目标而非量产承诺，工艺成熟度、良率和客户认证仍有待验证。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Nvidia GPU Prices Rise 87% in 17 Months as HBM Tightens
title.zh: HBM供应趋紧推动Nvidia GPU价格17个月上涨87%

summary.en: Nvidia GPU prices have climbed 87% over 17 months as tight HBM supply constrains accelerator availability, Seoul Economic Daily reports. The increase shows that memory availability is feeding directly into system pricing rather than remaining a component-level issue. It also raises the value of capacity commitments and alternative memory tiers for customers planning large AI clusters.
summary.zh: 据《首尔经济日报》报道，受HBM供应紧张限制加速器供给影响，Nvidia GPU价格在17个月内上涨87%。这说明存储供给已经直接传导至整机价格，不再只是元器件层面的问题。对于规划大型AI集群的客户而言，锁定产能和引入替代存储层的价值随之上升。

title.en: HBF Consortium Publishes Its First High Bandwidth Flash Specification
title.zh: HBF联盟发布首个High Bandwidth Flash规范

summary.en: The HBF consortium released its first High Bandwidth Flash specification, positioning flash as a new tier for AI workloads constrained by HBM capacity. HBF would not replace HBM's latency role, but a standardized high-bandwidth flash layer could keep larger model states closer to accelerators than conventional SSD storage. A specification is only the starting point; controller support, packaging, endurance, and shipping silicon will determine whether the tier becomes practical.
summary.zh: HBF联盟发布首个High Bandwidth Flash规范，试图为受HBM容量限制的AI工作负载增加新的存储层。HBF不会取代HBM的低延迟角色，但标准化的高带宽闪存层有望让更大规模的模型状态比传统SSD更靠近加速器。规范只是起点，控制器支持、封装、耐久性和实际出货芯片将决定这一层级能否落地。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Lam Research Plans More Than $3 Billion for Its Global Lab Network
title.zh: Lam Research拟投入逾$3B扩大全球实验室网络

summary.en: Lam Research plans to invest more than $3 billion to expand its global laboratory network. The spending signals that process development and customer co-engineering are scaling alongside AI-driven fab investment, particularly as new materials and 3D structures lengthen qualification cycles. The announcement is an investment envelope, and the timing and capacity added at individual sites will matter more than the headline total.
summary.zh: Lam Research计划投入超过$3B，扩大全球实验室网络。这笔投入表明，随着新材料和3D结构拉长验证周期，工艺开发与客户协同工程正和AI驱动的晶圆厂投资同步扩张。该数字属于投资总额框架，实际影响更取决于各站点的投入时间和新增能力。

title.en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Delays Its Glass-Substrate Investment
title.zh: Samsung Electro-Mechanics推迟半导体玻璃基板投资

summary.en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics has delayed an investment in semiconductor glass substrates. The move pushes out one prospective source of large, dimensionally stable substrates for advanced packages just as AI systems are driving package sizes upward. A delay does not invalidate the technology, but it does indicate that cost, process maturity, or customer timing has not yet cleared the company's investment threshold.
summary.zh: Samsung Electro-Mechanics已推迟半导体玻璃基板投资。在AI系统推动封装尺寸持续增大的背景下，这会延后一个潜在的大尺寸、高尺寸稳定性基板供应来源。推迟并不等于否定技术路线，但说明成本、工艺成熟度或客户导入时间尚未达到公司的投资门槛。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Washington Maps How China Rents Nvidia Chips It Cannot Buy
title.zh: 华盛顿追踪中国如何租用无法购买的Nvidia芯片

summary.en: US officials are mapping how Chinese users rent access to Nvidia chips that export controls prevent them from purchasing. The focus shifts enforcement from physical chip shipments toward remote compute and cloud access, where ownership and use occur in different jurisdictions. The mapping effort is not itself a new restriction, but it identifies the policy boundary likely to draw the next round of scrutiny.
summary.zh: 美国官员正在梳理中国用户如何租用因出口管制而无法直接购买的Nvidia芯片。监管重点由实体芯片出货延伸到远程算力和云端访问，因为设备所有权与实际使用可能分属不同司法辖区。此次梳理本身并非新限制，但指出了下一轮审查最可能聚焦的政策边界。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Applied Materials' Q4 Outlook Tops Expectations
title.zh: Applied Materials第四财季指引高于预期

summary.en: Applied Materials issued fourth-quarter revenue and earnings guidance above expectations, even as its shares slipped in after-hours trading. The outlook suggests wafer-fab equipment demand remains firm enough to support near-term results despite investor caution. With no forecast figures in the candidate feed, the significance is the direction of guidance rather than the size of the beat.
summary.zh: Applied Materials给出的第四财季收入和盈利指引高于市场预期，但股价在盘后交易中仍然下跌。这一展望说明，尽管投资者态度谨慎，晶圆制造设备需求仍足以支撑近期业绩。候选信息未提供具体预测数字，因此重点在于指引方向，而非超预期幅度。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Lightmatter Leads a 19-Company Silicon-Photonics Infrastructure Initiative
title.zh: Lightmatter牵头19家公司推进硅光基础设施标准化

summary.en: Lightmatter launched a 19-company initiative to standardize infrastructure ready for silicon photonics. The coalition gives optical I/O suppliers and system builders a shared architecture discussion as electrical interconnects encounter power and reach limits in larger AI clusters. Its value will depend on concrete specifications and adoption; formation of the group alone does not guarantee interoperable products.
summary.zh: Lightmatter发起由19家公司参与的计划，推动适配硅光技术的基础设施标准化。随着大型AI集群中的电互连遭遇功耗和传输距离限制，该联盟为光I/O供应商与系统厂商提供共同的架构讨论平台。其价值最终取决于具体规范和产业采用，仅成立组织并不能保证产品互操作。

title.en: Cerebras Runs OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol at 750 Tokens per Second
title.zh: Cerebras以每秒750个token运行OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol

summary.en: Cerebras is powering a new ultrafast tier for OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 tokens per second. A named, customer-facing deployment is meaningful evidence for wafer-scale inference beyond benchmark demonstrations, especially for latency-sensitive interactive workloads. The reported throughput does not by itself disclose batch size, context length, quality settings, or service economics, which are necessary for direct platform comparisons.
summary.zh: Cerebras为OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol的新ultrafast服务层提供算力，速度最高达到每秒750个token。具名且面向客户的部署，是晶圆级推理超越基准演示的重要证据，尤其适用于对延迟敏感的交互式工作负载。不过，该吞吐率未单独披露批量大小、上下文长度、质量设置和服务成本，尚不足以直接比较不同平台。

theme.en: Integration Moves from Devices to Full Systems
theme.zh: 集成从单器件走向完整系统

dek.en: This week's strongest work connects materials and devices to manufacturable stacks, network behavior, and system-level performance. Wafer-scale oxide integration, photonic compute, MoE switching, and tunable quantum structures all show that interfaces now determine whether a promising device becomes useful hardware.
dek.zh: 本周最值得关注的研究把材料与器件进一步连接到可制造堆叠、网络行为和系统级性能。晶圆级氧化物集成、光子计算、MoE交换与可调量子结构共同表明，接口设计正决定一种潜力器件能否成为实用硬件。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: 200 mm Wafer-Scale Monolithic 3D Integration of ALD Oxide Semiconductors
title.zh: 200 mm晶圆级ALD氧化物半导体单片3D集成

papers.authors: C. Niu, L. Long, L. Zheng, et al.

summary.en: The team fabricated more than 100,000 ALD InOx devices across three monolithically integrated tiers on 200 mm silicon, including ferroelectric and enhancement- and depletion-mode FETs. Threshold-voltage variation reaches 0.04 V standard deviation, electron mobility reaches 91.6 cm²/V·s, and cross-tier circuits operate; a modeled four-tier CIM accelerator delivers 1.4×–2.9× speedup over 2D baselines. The wafer-scale device data are the key result, while the accelerator comparison remains design-level evidence and the preprint does not yet establish production yield or long-term reliability.
summary.zh: 研究团队在200 mm硅片上单片集成三层、超过100,000个ALD InOx器件，包括铁电FET以及增强型和耗尽型FET。器件阈值电压标准差低至0.04 V，电子迁移率最高91.6 cm²/V·s，跨层电路可以工作；基于该工艺设计的四层CIM加速器相对2D基线获得1.4×–2.9×加速。晶圆级器件数据是核心成果，但加速器比较仍属于设计层证据，预印本也尚未证明量产良率和长期可靠性。

title.en: Telecom Light Sources from MoS₂/WSe₂ Moiré Superlattices on Silicon Photonics
title.zh: 硅光平台上的MoS₂/WSe₂莫尔超晶格通信波段光源

papers.authors: X. Huang, H. Fang, S. Kadkhodazadeh, et al.

summary.en: MoS₂/WSe₂ moiré superlattices coupled to a silicon-photonic nanobeam cavity produce a waveguide-integrated light source in the telecom O-band at room temperature. The device reports near-unity interference visibility and a coherence length of about 3.8 mm, substantially extending the coherence demonstrated by earlier 2D-material emitters. Stable ambient operation is encouraging for integration, although the paper does not by itself establish electrical pumping or foundry-scale manufacturing.
summary.zh: MoS₂/WSe₂莫尔超晶格与硅光纳米梁腔耦合，在室温下实现了通信O波段的波导集成光源。器件报告接近1的干涉可见度和约3.8 mm相干长度，明显超过此前二维材料发光器件的相干表现。其环境稳定性有利于集成，但论文尚不能证明电泵浦能力或晶圆代工规模的制造可行性。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: SLAC Exposes CPU-to-GPU Cache Side Channels on Apple Silicon
title.zh: SLAC揭示Apple Silicon上的CPU到GPU缓存侧信道

papers.authors: T. Xu, S. K. Roy, R. Ding, et al.

summary.en: SLAC shows that an unprivileged CPU process can observe cache-set footprints left by GPU memory accesses in the shared system-level cache of Apple Silicon. After reverse-engineering the M1 cache indexing, the authors build a Prime+Probe-style CPU-to-GPU channel; GPU-assisted priming increases covert-channel throughput by 6.4×. The result identifies a fine-grained cross-domain attack surface, but it is a preprint demonstrated on M1-class behavior and should not yet be generalized to every Apple generation.
summary.zh: SLAC发现，在Apple Silicon共享的系统级缓存中，非特权CPU进程可以观察GPU访存留下的缓存组足迹。团队逆向分析M1缓存索引后，构建了Prime+Probe式CPU到GPU侧信道；借助GPU进行预填充后，隐蔽信道吞吐率提高6.4×。该结果揭示了细粒度跨域攻击面，但目前仍是基于M1行为的预印本，不宜直接推广到所有Apple芯片世代。

title.en: Giant Backward Brillouin Interaction in Foundry-Accessible InP Photonics
title.zh: 可晶圆代工InP光子平台中的巨型后向布里渊相互作用

papers.authors: R. te Morsche, L. Puts, W. Yao, et al.

summary.en: The work reports the first measured backward stimulated Brillouin scattering in generic InP waveguides, with gain coefficients reaching 737 ± 54 W⁻¹m⁻¹. Achieving that interaction in a mature, foundry-accessible platform could add narrowband filtering, delay, and microwave-photonic functions without a bespoke material stack. The result is a preprint and the reported gain comes from a specific waveguide and acoustic-mode configuration, so circuit-scale loss and reproducibility remain the practical tests.
summary.zh: 该研究首次在通用InP波导中测得后向受激布里渊散射，增益系数最高达到737 ± 54 W⁻¹m⁻¹。在成熟、可晶圆代工的平台上获得这一相互作用，有望无需定制材料堆叠即可加入窄带滤波、延迟和微波光子功能。该结果仍是预印本，且高增益来自特定波导与声学模式配置，电路级损耗和重复性仍需验证。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: A Subvolt Dual-Mode Silicon Microring for Analog Optical Computing
title.zh: 面向模拟光计算的亚伏双模式硅微环

papers.authors: S. Biswas, S. M. Bari, A. X. Wang

summary.en: A MOSCAP silicon microring gated by a high-mobility transparent conductive oxide reaches 175 pm/V tuning efficiency, VπL of 0.09 V·cm, more than 6 dB extinction at 0.5 V, and 13.5 fJ/bit. Accumulation and depletion biasing let the same device encode 5- to 6-bit analog weights or provide a nonlinear optical response, reducing the need for separate photonic elements. These are strong measured device metrics, but scaling one ring into a calibrated multi-ring computing system remains the decisive systems challenge.
summary.zh: 一种由高迁移率透明导电氧化物栅控的MOSCAP硅微环实现175 pm/V调谐效率、0.09 V·cm的VπL、0.5 V驱动下超过6 dB消光比，以及13.5 fJ/bit能效。通过积累区和耗尽区偏置，同一器件既可编码5至6 bit模拟权重，也可提供非线性光响应，从而减少独立光子器件数量。器件实测指标很强，但从单个微环扩展到可校准的多微环计算系统仍是决定性的系统挑战。

title.en: Polarity-Addressed Reset Stabilizes SiNW-FET Reservoir Computing
title.zh: 极性寻址复位稳定SiNW-FET储备池计算

papers.authors: L. Yan, Y. Zhang, M. Wei, et al.

summary.en: Trap-engineered Schottky silicon-nanowire FETs use source-drain polarity reversal as a device-native reset that clears accumulated state during continuous event-stream inference. The authors integrate roughly 20 nm nanowires into an addressable 4×4 top-gated array and trigger sparse resets from online drift statistics, addressing a failure mode hidden by segmented benchmarks. The measured array makes the reliability problem concrete, though its small scale and gesture-recognition workload leave larger reservoirs and broader tasks untested.
summary.zh: 陷阱工程Schottky硅纳米线FET利用源漏极性反转实现器件原生复位，在连续事件流推理中清除累积状态。研究团队把直径约20 nm的纳米线集成为可寻址4×4顶栅阵列，并根据在线漂移统计稀疏触发复位，解决分段基准测试会掩盖的失效模式。实测阵列把可靠性问题具体化，但规模较小且仅使用手势识别任务，更大储备池和更广泛工作负载仍未验证。

title.en: AI Research for Hardware
title.zh: 面向硬件的AI研究

title.en: HyNA Uses Hybrid Switch Silicon to Tame MoE Tail Latency
title.zh: HyNA以混合交换芯片抑制MoE尾延迟

papers.authors: Y. Liu, T. Liu, H. Yao

summary.en: HyNA combines wire-speed reconfigurable match tables with embedded RISC-V cores so sparse, bursty MoE aggregation—including collisions and overflow handling—stays inside the switch ASIC. The design removes dedicated parameter-server nodes and is evaluated with a 100 Gbps FPGA prototype plus 7 nm ASIC synthesis, turning host fallback round trips into deterministic on-chip handling. The systems idea directly targets MoE communication tails, but the final performance and power claims still mix prototype measurements with synthesized rather than taped-out silicon.
summary.zh: HyNA把线速可重构匹配表与嵌入式RISC-V核心结合，使稀疏、突发的MoE聚合流量连同冲突和溢出处理都留在交换ASIC内部。该设计取消专用参数服务器节点，并通过100 Gbps FPGA原型和7 nm ASIC综合评估，把主机回退的网络往返变为确定性的片上处理。其系统思路直接针对MoE通信尾延迟，但最终性能与功耗结论仍混合了原型实测和综合结果，而非流片芯片数据。

title.en: Quantum & Nonlinear Photonics
title.zh: 量子与非线性光子学

title.en: Tunable Bound States Reshape Four-Wave Mixing in SiN Microresonators
title.zh: 可调连续域束缚态重塑SiN微谐振器四波混频

papers.authors: E. C. Lima, M. Clementi, A. Viola, et al.

summary.en: An electrically tunable Friedrich-Wintgen bound state in the continuum reaches Q above 10⁶ in coupled silicon-nitride microresonators and can be populated through spontaneous four-wave mixing despite being dark to linear excitation. Placing the idler at the bound-state condition increases parametric gain by 12 dB and lowers the oscillation threshold by 1.6 dB, while changing photon-pair correlations and coherence. The experiment points to reconfigurable quantum and nonlinear sources, but it remains a preprint and does not yet address packaging, control overhead, or device-to-device variation.
summary.zh: 耦合SiN微谐振器中的电可调Friedrich-Wintgen连续域束缚态实现超过10⁶的Q值；尽管线性激励无法直接访问，该模式仍可通过自发四波混频被占据。把闲频模式调到束缚态条件后，参量增益提高12 dB，振荡阈值降低1.6 dB，同时改变光子对的关联与相干性。该实验为可重构量子和非线性光源提供路径，但目前仍是预印本，尚未处理封装、控制开销和器件间差异。
